occurrences.narration_excerpt_or_silent_purpose: The narrator introduces a young Ada facing the Analytical Engine. Ada explains that everyone else saw arithmetic, while she understood that precisely written instructions could let a machine work with symbols, set them to music and follow a step-by-step method; she then warns that the machine has no power to originate anything.

Rain falls outside, candles glow and a gold musical-note trail grows from the machinery into oversized foreground notes. Across the five seconds, the camera and Ada's face, pose and scale shift substantially instead of remaining locked.
